newsitem.title: USA: Culligan files 4.99 mln shr secondary offer.
newsitem.headline: Culligan files 4.99 mln shr secondary offer.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the secondary offering of up to 4,994,921 common shares.
The Northbrook, Ill.,-based company said that of the offering, investeor Carl Icahn, a former director, plans to sell up to 3,451,803 shares, representing a 17.3 percent stake.
Investor Steve Green, also a former director, plans to sell up to 1,543,118 shares, representing a 7.5 percent stake, the company said.
Culligan, a water purification and treatment products and services company, said it will not received proceeds from the sale.
It said the offering will be made through Goldman, Sachs & Co, Bear Stearns & Co Inc, Natwest Securities Ltd, Smith Barney Inc and Jefferies & Co.
The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 599,391 additional shares, the company said.
